nodes.label: Root Makefile
nodes.rationale: Mandatory canonical control surface — the single entry point for setup, running, testing, linting, and building. No step exists outside the Makefile.

nodes.label: TDD Development Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Write the test first, then the implementation. Tests mirror the structure of the module they test. No function ships without a test. API routes are thin — logic lives in core/.

nodes.label: DuckDB over MySQL Decision
nodes.rationale: OLAP-optimized, in-process, no server. dbt transforms create analytics-ready models. Agent queries denormalized marts, not raw transactional tables.

nodes.label: HIPAA-Compliant Local-Only Backend
nodes.rationale: Real patient data never leaves the developer's machine. Frontend on Vercel is a static shell displaying a not-connected notice. Backend, DB, and infra run locally via docker-compose.

nodes.label: Tiered Query Strategy
nodes.rationale: Tier 1: Single mart queries (80%). Tier 2: Two-mart joins on shared patient_id (15%). Tier 3: Edge queries via staging fallback with SchemaGraph pathfinder (5%). Graph preserved as safety net, not default path.

nodes.label: RAG as Deterministic Preprocessing
nodes.rationale: RAG runs once before the graph as a deterministic step instead of being an LLM tool costing roundtrips. Eliminates 3 graph nodes, zero LLM roundtrips spent on table discovery, schema context provided upfront.

nodes.label: Sandbox Security Properties
nodes.rationale: --network none prevents exfiltration, read-only DB mount prevents data modification, CPU/mem caps + timeout prevent resource exhaustion, pids-limit prevents fork bombs.
